method: Temporary instrumentation of the real dashboard and renderer; 2s warmup + 8s sample; asynchronous WebGL2 GPU timer queries. No production source edits.
notes: A standalone localhost preview, not native DSH whole-app, cold-network or cross-device benchmarking.
Counter revision 1 counted both named actor root and named imported scene. actors normalized to independent skeleton count; raw name matches retained.
Material texture byte estimates use upload deduplication only in counter revision 2. Earlier values overcount one shared texture upload by about 5.33 MiB.
Initial one-actor sample taken before closing three earlier preview tabs is excluded from the main comparison.
FPS is actual drawn frames, capped in production at 30; CPU time is synchronous frame work, not whole-process CPU utilization.
Texture memory estimates exclude internal skeletal/morph textures, shadows, PMREM/LTC, framebuffers and driver allocation.
The DPR 1 no-shadow exploratory sample is excluded: two actors were still loading when its sampling window began.
